decisions.choice: Maintainer delivery rides the proven SwarmPocket rail, generalized: merge an app change -> CI builds and publishes the APK to a rolling GitHub release -> cp-1 pulls it within 30 minutes -> the update banner appears on the phone over WireGuard -> one-tap install. decisions.question: How do merged app changes reach the maintainer's phone (and the public)?
decisions.rationale: Maintainer's stated pipeline: 'merge an app change -> CI builds and publishes to a rolling release -> cp-1 pulls it within 30 minutes -> the pink banner appears on your phone -> one tap'. Implementable only once the build lane produces an APK and CI exists.

decisions.choice: Version RepoGlance with semver Git tags (OpenClaw-style vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH plus -beta.N). Pushing a tag runs release.yml, which builds a signed AAB + APK and publishes a GitHub Release (APK + SHA256SUMS attached, curated changelog body); versionCode is derived monotonically from the tag. The per-push rolling canary is dropped -- releases are cut only on tags. The Play Store becomes the primary distribution and update channel for the maintainer's phone and the public, with the AAB uploaded to a Play internal track via a service account. Release signing (upload keystore) and CI/Play secrets are maintainer-gated.
